about.title: About
about.intro: I am a security-focused engineer based in Argentina 🇦🇷, currently transitioning from a robust background in Full-Stack development to Application Security (AppSec).
about.education: As an Electronic Engineering student at the National Technological University (UTN), I bring a unique "under-the-hood" perspective to cybersecurity—understanding not just the code, but the hardware and protocols that power it.
about.mindset: I am proactive, collaborative, and driven by a security-first mindset. I thrive in DevOps environments where I can automate vulnerability management, harden cloud infrastructures, and advocate for best practices like the OWASP Top 10.

timeline.title: Impact
timeline.subtitle: Key milestones in application security and software engineering

milestones.title: Application Security Engineer @ Personal Pay
milestones.description: Leading Snyk (SCA/SAST) implementation within GitLab CI/CD, reducing critical vulnerabilities across the organization. Hardening AWS environments (IAM, Secrets Manager, S3) and building custom security automation tools using Go and Rust.

milestones.title: Backend Developer @ Personal Pay
milestones.description: Developed scalable microservices for the Personal Identity team using NestJS, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. Designed and maintained cloud solutions on AWS (API Gateway, SQS, CloudFront).

milestones.title: Backend Developer @ Agripay
milestones.description: Managed backend microservices using PHP and Laravel. Implemented continuous integration pipelines with GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment. Containerization with Docker.

milestones.title: Full Stack Developer @ Innovus Software
milestones.description: Built and maintained mobile and web applications, including deployment to App Store and Play Store. Managed server deployment and cloud services like AWS and Digital Ocean.

milestones.title: Full Stack Developer @ Global Médica S.A
milestones.description: Led design, development, and maintenance of a CRM system using Laravel with over 5000 users for a chain of pharmacies and orthopedic facilities. Served as team leader.

milestones.title: Full Stack Developer Jr @ La Rioja's Municipality
milestones.description: Designed and developed web applications for municipal departments using Laravel and WordPress. Gained experience in deployment, maintenance, and API implementation.
